_comment: PORTFOLIO COPY — redacted schema for the Agency Operations Airtable base. Table/field shapes preserved; live base IDs, collaborator emails, and client examples removed. Per ADR 0020 this is a single base (Accounts/Contacts/Contracts + delivery). Schema drift is never auto-applied. See docs/runbooks/airtable_operations_base_setup.md.
_base_purpose: Single Airtable base for a client-services agency. Owns Accounts, Contacts, Contracts, and delivery (Projects, Tasks, Goals, Goal Scores, Team, Risk Profiles, Service Catalog).

Accounts.description: Companies the agency works with — the canonical client record (post-ADR-0020 collapse). Carries both sales-side fields (Total Lifetime Value, Industry) and operational fields (Segment, Status, Account Manager, HIPAA). Replaces the old Clients table. The sensitive-account (HIPAA) checkbox is load-bearing (PRD §4.1 layer 2) — false on every row today; flipping it removes the account and all linked Projects/Contacts/Contracts/Tasks from sync.

fields.name: Client Status
fields.notes: Sales-side status (legacy CRM field). Operations.Status below is the canonical operational status used by the Brain.

fields.name: Industry (AI)
fields.notes: Airtable-AI-generated industry label.

fields.name: Segment
fields.notes: Drives Risk Watcher subclass selection (spec §6.1–§6.3).

fields.name: Status
fields.notes: Canonical operational status — the Brain reads this, not Client Status above.

fields.name: Account Manager
fields.notes: Default Owner for Projects spawned for this account.

fields.name: HIPAA
fields.notes: LOAD-BEARING (PRD §4.1 layer 2). If true, this account and all linked Projects/Tasks/Contacts/Contracts are excluded from BigQuery sync at the Airtable filterByFormula layer. Manual control only — never written by an agent. Flag defaults false; enable only for regulated/sensitive accounts.

fields.name: Engagement End Date
fields.notes: Empty if engagement is active.

fields.name: Risk Baseline
fields.notes: JSON. Maintained by Risk Watcher (WS-G2). Humans don't edit.

fields.name: Vantage Tenant ID
fields.notes: Pointer to the account's Vantage data location for cross-reference (when applicable).

fields.name: Pending Updates
fields.notes: ADR 0047 / CRM Auto-updater. Long-text staging area where the Auto-updater appends timestamped suggestions (new contacts, mention context, status nudges). Drafts-only per PRD §4.7 — humans read, decide what to commit, delete the block. Non-canonical; never read back by another agent. Type bumped to richText 2026-05-28 per audit F10 — Airtable UI auto-upgraded the column.

Contacts.description: People associated with Accounts. The Triage Agent's sender resolver (PR 4g) joins Gmail.sender → Contacts.Email → Account → Project. sensitive-account cascade: Contacts inherits Account.HIPAA via the Account HIPAA lookup field; airtable_to_bq applies filterByFormula=NOT({Account HIPAA}). Personal CRM fields (Warmth, Last Contact, Next Followup, Relationship Type) added per ADR 0042; the Account link becomes optional in practice for personal contacts (the schema-level required constraint stays for backward compat with existing rows; sync's HIPAA filter handles null-lookup correctly).

fields.name: Email
fields.notes: JOIN KEY for sender_to_project_v — Gmail.sender exact-match lands here.

fields.name: Account
fields.notes: Required so sensitive-account cascade has an Account context.

fields.name: Warmth
fields.notes: ADR 0042 / PKM Phase 4. Personal-CRM warmth grade. Drives PersonalReEngagementSignal severity escalation (Hot/Warm + 2× threshold → high; Hot OR 2× threshold → medium; otherwise low). Manually maintained.

fields.name: Last Contact
fields.notes: ADR 0042 / PKM Phase 4. Date of last meaningful contact. Read directly by PersonalReEngagementSignal as the recency baseline. v1 manual; future write surface deferred.

fields.name: Next Followup
fields.notes: ADR 0042 / PKM Phase 4. Optional explicit followup date. NOT consumed by v1 signal — UI affordance + reserved for future Personal Brief.

fields.name: Relationship Type
fields.notes: ADR 0042 / PKM Phase 4. Drives per-relationship-type recency thresholds in PersonalReEngagementSignal (Friend/Other 60d, Mentor/Mentee 30d, Collaborator 21d, Family 90d). PersonalClientStateLoader gates on this being non-null — work-only contacts (null) are excluded from the Personal segment.

fields.name: Account HIPAA
fields.notes: LOAD-BEARING (PRD §4.1 layer 2). Lookup of Accounts.HIPAA via the Account link. airtable_to_bq applies filterByFormula=NOT({Account HIPAA}). Derived field — never replicated to BigQuery (filtered out by schema_mapping.py).

fields.name: Pending Updates
fields.notes: ADR 0047 / CRM Auto-updater. Long-text staging area where the Auto-updater appends timestamped suggestions (Last Contact / Next Followup / Warmth / new context). Drafts-only per PRD §4.7 — humans read and manually update the canonical fields. Non-canonical; never read back by another agent. Type bumped to richText 2026-05-28 per audit F10 — Airtable UI auto-upgraded the column.

Contracts.description: Formal agreements with clients. Linked to Accounts via the Account field. Projects link to Contracts via Projects.Contract (replaces the legacy Source Contract Record ID text field). sensitive-account cascade via Account HIPAA lookup.

fields.name: Services
fields.notes: Multi-select. Option list manually kept aligned with Service Catalog row names.

fields.name: Account HIPAA
fields.notes: LOAD-BEARING. Same cascade pattern as Contacts.Account HIPAA.

Projects.description: Active units of work delivery. Linked to Accounts (one Account, many Projects) and optionally to a Contract. Per ADR 0020, the legacy Client link and Source Contract Record ID text field are replaced by Account (linked) and Contract (linked).

fields.name: Project Name
fields.notes: Convention: '{Account} — {Service} — {Period or Phase}'. e.g. 'Acme Corp — Website Design — Q2 2026'.

fields.name: Account
fields.notes: Replaces the legacy Client link (ADR 0020).

fields.name: Service
fields.notes: Linked record to Service Catalog, NOT a single-select. Single source of truth for service offerings (ADR 0011).

fields.name: Contract
fields.notes: Optional — replaces the legacy Source Contract Record ID text field (ADR 0020). A retainer Contract may spawn multiple Projects.

fields.name: Health
fields.notes: Set manually OR by Risk Watcher. Yellow/Red requires Health Reason.

fields.name: Health Reason
fields.notes: Required when Health ∈ {Yellow, Red}. What's off, recovery plan, when we expect Green again.

fields.name: Owner
fields.notes: Defaults from Account.Account Manager when blank. Brain-drafted Tasks default to this Owner.

fields.name: Contributors
fields.notes: Other team members working on this Project.

fields.name: Actual End Date
fields.notes: Filled when Status = Complete.

fields.name: Scope Document
fields.notes: URL to the signed scope/SOW in Drive.

fields.name: Goal Linked
fields.notes: Optional — for Projects that directly advance a strategic goal.

fields.name: Tasks
fields.notes: Reverse link populated by Tasks.Project.

fields.name: Open Tasks Count
fields.notes: Configured as a Count field in Airtable filtering on the linked Tasks.

fields.name: Account HIPAA
fields.notes: LOAD-BEARING (PRD §4.1 layer 2). Lookup of Accounts.HIPAA via the Account link. airtable_to_bq applies filterByFormula=NOT({Account HIPAA}) at the source query so the sensitive-account cascade reaches Projects at the Airtable API layer. Derived field — never replicated to BigQuery (filtered out by schema_mapping.py). Replaces the legacy Client HIPAA lookup (ADR 0020).

fields.name: GitHub Repo URL
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Optional pointer to the Project's primary GitHub repository for orchestrator handoff.

fields.name: Orchestrator Inbox
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Reverse view of Orchestrator Inbox.Project link.

Tasks.description: Operational task list — the Brain's primary write target. Tasks created by Triage / Risk Watcher / Goal Steward arrive with Approval Status = 'Drafted by Agent' and are reviewed by the human Owner before being approved.

fields.name: Source
fields.notes: NULLABLE at BQ sync layer — tasks manually created in Airtable without a Source set must not block the sync. All agent writers (Triage, CRM Auto-updater) set this explicitly. Required at Airtable UI level via validation rules.

fields.name: Source Reference
fields.notes: Link back to the originating signal: Gmail thread, Drive doc, calendar event.

fields.name: Project
fields.notes: Required so sensitive-account cascade and ownership inheritance always have a Project context.

fields.name: Account
fields.notes: Auto-derived from Project. Stored as a lookup so Tasks views can filter/group by Account without a separate join.

fields.name: Owner
fields.notes: Brain-drafted Tasks default to Project.Owner when account_owners_v can resolve it; otherwise NULL — humans set on approval per ADR 0022. Manual Tasks: Owner is set explicitly.

fields.name: Action Type
fields.notes: GTD model. Drives WS-D routing matrix. Drafts arriving via CRM Auto-updater (Approval Status = 'Drafted by Agent') legitimately have NULL Action Type — the human picks the GTD bucket at approval time. Required at Airtable UI level via validation rules, but allowed to be NULL at the sync/BQ layer.

fields.name: Task Type
fields.notes: 'Project' here means multi-step task. Most rows are 'Task'.

fields.name: Wait Reason
fields.notes: Required when Action Type = Wait.

fields.name: Wait Started
fields.notes: Required when Action Type = Wait. Drives aging logic.

fields.name: Goal Linked
fields.notes: Optional — for Tasks that advance a specific goal.

fields.name: Approval Status
fields.notes: Brain-drafted Tasks land as 'Drafted by Agent'. 'Rejected' captures dismissed drafts for false-positive analysis (PRD §13).

fields.name: Project HIPAA
fields.notes: LOAD-BEARING (PRD §4.1 layer 2). Transitive lookup of Accounts.HIPAA via Project.Account HIPAA. airtable_to_bq applies filterByFormula=NOT({Project HIPAA}) at the source query so the sensitive-account cascade reaches Tasks at the Airtable API layer. Derived field — never replicated to BigQuery. Field name kept as 'Project HIPAA' (not renamed) so hipaa_filters.py needs no rename.

fields.name: Technical Brief
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Optional structured brief for the orchestrator handoff.

fields.name: Context Snippet
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Optional context excerpt captured from the source signal.

fields.name: Git Branch
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Optional git branch name for orchestrator handoff.

fields.name: PR Link
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Optional GitHub PR URL once the task lands a PR.

fields.name: Orchestrator Inbox
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Free-text ID of the upstream Orchestrator Inbox row that spawned this Task. Stored as text (not a link) per the live Airtable shape.

Goals.description: Hierarchical strategic goals. Long-horizon goals contain shorter-horizon goals via Parent Goal links. Goal Steward (WS-G6) maintains Last Reviewed and prompts owners weekly for Goal Scores.

fields.name: Owner
fields.notes: Single-founder build: strategic goals are seeded from the goal hierarchy without an owner. Relaxed to non-required so ownerless goals don't fail the BQ sync (mirrors Tasks.Owner, commit 5ac5d0b7).

fields.name: Parent Goal
fields.notes: Required UNLESS Horizon = 10-year. Hierarchy invariant: parent's horizon must be longer (Weekly→Quarterly, Quarterly→1-year, 1-year→3-year, 3-year→10-year).

fields.name: Description
fields.notes: What the goal is in human language.

fields.name: Tactics
fields.notes: The 'how' — specific moves planned to achieve it.

fields.name: Metrics
fields.notes: The numeric or observable definition of success.

fields.name: Last Reviewed
fields.notes: Updated by Goal Steward weekly when the owner submits a Goal Score.

fields.name: Goal Scores
fields.notes: Reverse link populated by Goal Scores.Goal.

fields.name: Tasks Linked
fields.notes: Reverse link populated by Tasks.Goal Linked.

fields.name: Orchestrator Inbox
fields.notes: Audit F11 (2026-05-28). Reverse view of Orchestrator Inbox.Goal link.

Goal Scores.description: One row per goal per week. Time-series of self-assessment scores feeding the Weekly Synthesizer (WS-G5).

fields.name: Score Name
fields.notes: Convention: '{Goal Name} — {YYYY-MM-DD}'. Goal Steward populates this when creating the row.

fields.name: Week Of
fields.notes: Monday of the week being scored.

fields.name: Score
fields.notes: 1-10 self-assessment.

fields.name: Notes
fields.notes: Why this score. Captured from the Chat prompt response.

Team.description: Team member registry. Workspace email is the join key for Brain ownership resolution — the Brain looks up the User collaborator's email and matches it to a row here. The User singleCollaborator carries the Airtable usrXXX id (ADR 0019); the Triage Agent uses it to populate Tasks.Owner explicitly when drafting.

fields.name: Workspace Email
fields.notes: JOIN KEY. Must match the user's @example.com Workspace identity.

fields.name: User
fields.notes: Airtable user collaborator. Sync extracts the usrXXX id (not email — Workspace Email already carries that). The Brain joins this in sender_to_project_v to populate Tasks.Owner explicitly when drafting (ADR 0019).

fields.name: Active
fields.notes: Inactive members stay in the table for historical attribution but aren't candidates for new Project ownership.

fields.name: Capacity Hours per Week
fields.notes: Working capacity. Drives future utilization dashboards (deferred from v1).

Service Catalog.description: Single source of truth for service offerings. Projects.Service is a linked record to this table. Adding a new service = add a row here; no schema migration anywhere else.

fields.name: Service Code
fields.notes: Short identifier for filenames/queries. Must be unique. e.g. 'vantage-local', 'website-design', 'paid-ads-mgmt'.

fields.name: Category
fields.notes: Drives how Projects are spawned. Platform Subscription = no Projects expected; Project-Based = one Project per engagement; Retainer = one rolling Project per month.

fields.name: Default Phase Sequence
fields.notes: Free-text default phase progression. e.g. 'Discovery → Design → Build → Launch → Closeout'.

fields.name: Default Deliverables
fields.notes: Bulleted list of typical deliverables.

fields.name: Standard Pricing Notes
fields.notes: Reference for sales — 'starts at $X for Y', 'monthly retainer Z'.

fields.name: Active
fields.notes: Sunset old services without losing historical Projects linked to them.

fields.name: Projects
fields.notes: Reverse link populated by Projects.Service.

Risk Profiles.description: Per-segment trouble-signal config. Risk Watcher (WS-G2) reads these rows on each invocation to know what patterns to evaluate per segment. Adding a new pattern = add a row; the agent picks it up on the next run.

fields.name: Pattern Name
fields.notes: e.g. 'Acknowledgment Gap', 'Silent After Deliverable', 'Klaviyo List Decline'.

fields.name: Description
fields.notes: What the pattern detects + why it matters.

fields.name: Threshold Value
fields.notes: Numeric threshold (e.g. 5 for '5 days'). Optional — some patterns are boolean.

fields.name: Threshold Unit
fields.notes: Unit for the threshold (e.g. 'business days', '%', 'count'). Free-text.

fields.name: Window
fields.notes: Comparison window (e.g. 'rolling 8 weeks', 'since last delivery'). Free-text.

Captures.description: Quick-capture form target for the PKM merge (ADR 0037 §3). A public Airtable form view writes one row per submission. The Captures materializer (Phase 0 follow-up Cloud Run Job) reads airtable_replica.captures, materializes rows into agent_outputs.notes (scope='personal', note_kind='inbox'), sets Synced + Synced At, then deletes the Airtable row after one full sync cycle has confirmed the BQ write. Delete-after-sync prevents data loss if BQ INSERT succeeds but Airtable DELETE fails.

fields.name: Captured At
fields.notes: Auto-populated. Used as the BQ row's created_at when materialized.

fields.name: Id
fields.notes: Auto-incrementing Airtable ID. Added in Airtable 2026-05; brought into schema 2026-05-28 per audit F11. Not used by the materializer (record._airtable_record_id is canonical) but replicated for completeness.

fields.name: Note Text
fields.notes: The capture body. Materialized into agent_outputs.notes.markdown_content. Required at the Airtable UI level via the form's validation; allowed to be NULL at the sync/BQ layer because pre-form-validation rows (one observed 2026-05-06, record recad5cpr1dMpJsMY) can legitimately have empty Note Text and would otherwise block the entire airtable_replica.captures load.

fields.name: Kind
fields.notes: Capture kind. 'note' → agent_outputs.notes (default). 'decision' → agent_outputs.decisions with status='draft'. 'win' → agent_outputs.wins. 'todo' → asb-triage-input publish (so it lands in the agency triage queue alongside other actionable inputs).

fields.name: Scope Hint
fields.notes: Default 'personal'. Surfaced as the BQ row's scope column. The materializer respects this hint; downstream queries filter accordingly.

fields.name: Synced
fields.notes: Set TRUE by the materializer after a successful BQ write. The deletion guard waits one additional sync cycle past Synced=TRUE before deleting the Airtable row, so a sync failure never loses capture content.

fields.name: Synced At
fields.notes: Date the row was synced (configure the Airtable date field with 'Include time' enabled if you want sub-day granularity). Drives the delete-after-sync guard along with the BQ replica's _synced_at system column.

Orchestrator Inbox.description: Developer-workflow inbox for orchestrator requests against Projects and Goals (added in Airtable 2026-05; brought into schema 2026-05-28 per audit finding F7). Centralizes incoming requests with their links to Projects, Goals, and the Tasks they spawn. No sensitive-account cascade — entries are operator-authored against internal projects.

fields.name: Title
fields.notes: Short label for the request.

fields.name: Body
fields.notes: Request body — what the orchestrator should act on.

fields.name: Project
fields.notes: Optional Project link (single preferred). Joined with Goal to scope the request.

fields.name: Goal
fields.notes: Optional Goal link (single preferred).

fields.name: Priority
fields.notes: Integer priority (precision 0 in Airtable). Caller-set.

fields.name: Repo Hint
fields.notes: Optional repo identifier (e.g. 'agency-brain') for the implementer.

fields.name: Status
fields.notes: Option list reflects the live Airtable state as of 2026-05-28; update both sides together.

fields.name: Synced At
fields.notes: Timestamp of last orchestrator sync against this row.

fields.name: Created Task
fields.notes: Airtable record id of the spawned Task (recXXX). Free-text for now; not a linked field.

fields.name: Sync Error
fields.notes: Populated by the orchestrator on sync failure for operator visibility.

_portfolio_note: The checkbox field remains named HIPAA in this schema because sync filters, lookup cascades, and security tests key off that exact field name. In product language this is sensitive / regulated-account isolation — flipping the flag excludes the account and linked records from BigQuery sync.
